title: HarmChip: Evaluating Hardware Security Centric LLM Safety via Jailbreak Benchmarking
reasoning: The paper focuses on evaluating the safety and security of LLMs in the specific technical domain of hardware design and security. It measures jailbreak success rates for hardware-level threats like Trojans and side-channel attacks, but does not benchmark or evaluate religion, faith, spiritual traditions, or general moral/ethical reasoning frameworks.
